author: Bellular News
description:
The last time GTA Online got an update, Fortnite and Battlefield both lost hundreds of thousands of players. Now Epic is dangling two weeks of free cosmetics just as GTA 6 arrives. Other publishers have moved their games into early 2027. If the reports about a PC port are right, where does that leave them?

Join us at https://bellular.games for early access content, 20 editions of 'Loading Screen' a month and to support our team!

00:00 What One GTA Online Update Did to Fortnite
01:08 Epic’s Bribe
03:29 GTA 6 Pre-orders Put the Hype in Perspective
05:08 Why Nobody Will Launch Against GTA
06:12 The Indies Betting on Steam
07:42 What Happens When GTA 6 Comes to PC?
